caption: The decoder computes the three checks from the received word 0110001 and gets s₃s₂s₁ = 110. Read as a binary number, 110 is 6, so it flips bit 6 and recovers the codeword 0110011, whose data bits give back the message 1011.

spec.title: Hamming(7,4): syndrome finds the flipped bit
spec.aria: The codeword 0110011 is sent and 0110001 arrives with bit 6 flipped; the syndrome s₃s₂s₁ = 110 reads as 6, the decoder flips bit 6 back and the data bits give the message 1011.
